links.outcome: Readability of LLM stoma information (Flesch-Kincaid, Flesch Reading Ease, Coleman-Liau)
links.effect: All responses from all four LLMs required high school to college level education to comprehend comfortably; CoPilot and ChatGPT-4 performed better on readability.
links.quote: All responses required high school to college level education to comprehend comfortably.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the readability and reliability of four LLMs in answering peri-operative questions for stoma patients, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
